dataPreservation.incident: The first full simulator baseline invoked the existing uninstall step and deleted the old App data container, including the default Documents/chat-host and the unarchived v45 isolated workspace.
dataPreservation.fix: PDSH_SIM_PRESERVE_DATA=1 avoids uninstall, generates an isolated test workspace and clears only test reports. Preserve diagnostics go to stderr so command substitution captures only the container path. The simctl XCTest fallback forwards the isolated workspace name too.
dataPreservation.verified: The v3 preserve run passed all 85 tests and retained the new sentinel across container migration.
dataPreservation.sentinelMeaning: A newly created integration sentinel only; it is not a recovered user session.

historicalFailures.reason: Foreground projection/interaction lifecycle prevented the original matrix from completing; v47 passed after the fix.
Inherited test state affected full-Web; isolation was added rather than deleting the test.

Preserve diagnostics contaminated the captured container path, so stale report/kill markers were not cleared and WebContent was killed before readiness. v3 corrected the output channel and passed the same full gate.

scopeBoundaries: This is a native office vertical slice on the existing Phone DSH app, not the Personal App Runtime, an App Store distribution system or a second app.
The upstream DSH checkout and its Agent loop were not patched.
The 19 phone tools cover ArtifactStore, file selection/listing, PDF text/page rendering, OOXML/CSV reads, new-file generation, charts, preview/share, optional OCR and bounded system integrations.
The current tools do not promise arbitrary Office editing, formula recalculation, full-fidelity Office conversion, general web scraping or universal document support.

Derived-page caching across tasks, read-only projection/eviction, bounded IR self-repair telemetry, large-file physical-device memory and physical-device flight mode still require separate acceptance.
GitHub coding, cloud build sandboxes, CRM write-back and Personal App skills/runtime are architecture stages, not capabilities claimed by this receipt.
Generic sk-<token> scans over the tracked workspace and textual simulator evidence returned no matches; this is not a claim that arbitrary untracked private files were inspected.
